title: Comparing the CA3080, AS3080, LM13600 and LM13700 OTAs
summary: Why the LM13700 is not quite "two CA3080s in one package": a look at the current mirrors inside each OTA (Widlar, Wilson, PNP versions) and the differences between the LM13600 and LM13700 that matter in synth circuits.

sources.title: Comparing the CA3080, AS3080E, LM13600 and LM13700 OTAs
sources.author: Tom Wiltshire (Electric Druid)
